note: Auton duplicate impersonating Mickey at the restaurant.
Clive shows Rose the family photograph taken before the Titanic sailed.
Guest aboard Platform One.
Cassandra’s sabotage devices attack staff and disable safety systems.
Wears Oliver Charles and subsequently General Asquith.
The human general appears before the Slitheen takes his skin.
The dead prime minister is shown. The television story does not name him.
Arrives disguised as the Scottish Parliament official.
The Doctor moves his body.
Arrives disguised as the boating club chair.
Arrives at Downing Street disguised as the RAF group captain.
A detached Cyberman head is displayed in the collection.
Seen on the Bad Wolf channel.
The creature above the Editor on Floor 500.
His first telephone call bleeds through time.
Child incarnation of Mickey, portrayed here by Casey Dyer.
Creatures consume people inside the disrupted timeline.
Transformed patients in Albion Hospital.
Jack uses the medical particles aboard his ship.
The transformed patients follow the child.
The ambulance particles use Nancy to repair Jamie.
The earlier Bad Wolf channel image reappears in the montage.
Rose remembers her warning about the big bad wolf.
The Doctor confronts the survivor aboard the flagship.
Volunteers to defend the station.
Also appears as the emergency-programme hologram.
Includes the empowered Bad Wolf state of Rose.
The Ninth Doctor regenerates aboard the TARDIS.
